name: @drizzle-super-seed/example-mariadb
description: drizzle-super-seed bulk extended-INSERT files for MariaDB and MySQL

scripts.image:build: npm run generate && docker build -t drizzle-super-seed-park-mariadb .
scripts.image:run: docker run --rm -e MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=park -e MARIADB_DATABASE=park -e MARIADB_USER=park -e MARIADB_PASSWORD=park -p 53306:3306 drizzle-super-seed-park-mariadb
scripts.image:build:prebaked: npm run generate && docker build -f Dockerfile.prebaked -t drizzle-super-seed-park-mariadb-prebaked .
